2ef8594a-3552-487a-ad4f-fc8f2a03cffc.content:
fix: GrepHandler.searchStdin() now supports -A/-B/-C context line options

Root cause: searchStdin() ignored contextBefore/contextAfter/contextBoth options,
only outputting matching lines without surrounding context. This caused
`cat file | grep -A N pattern` to lose context lines in the pipeline.

Changes:
- Rewrote searchStdin() with two-pass algorithm: find matches, then collect context
- Fixed contextBoth default from 1 to 0 (matching native grep behavior)
- Added grep-style "--" separators between non-contiguous context groups
- Added grep-style line number separators (":" for match, "-" for context)
- Added 8 new test cases covering -A, -B, -C, edge cases, and separators
